verdict.rationale: Bugbot's own docs provide one-click handoff from a finding to an agent fix: 'Fix in Web' opens the issue in cursor.com/agents and 'Fix in Cursor' opens it in the IDE. Inline comments also include suggested fixes. Both handoff paths take the developer off the PR surface, though, and no evidence shows a fix being committed back to the PR branch automatically. missing for 10: an in-PR apply or commit of the patch, documentation that the agent pushes the fix to the PR branch, and independent hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I turn a review finding into an applied fix — a committed patch or an agent-generated follow-up — without leaving the PR

citations.quote: Fix in Web links open issues directly in cursor.com/agents
Fix in Cursor links open issues directly in Cursor
leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes
